items.question: 上个月的MRR是多少
items.gold_sql:
SELECT SUM(l.seats * l.unit_price) AS value
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN companies c ON i.company_id = c.company_id JOIN plans p ON l.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

items.question: 各套餐档位的MRR
items.gold_sql:
SELECT p.tier AS tier, SUM(l.seats * l.unit_price) AS value
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN companies c ON i.company_id = c.company_id JOIN plans p ON l.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE TRUE
GROUP BY p.tier
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

items.question: 各档位毛利率
items.gold_sql:
SELECT p.tier AS tier, ((SUM(l.seats * l.unit_price)) - (SUM(l.seats * p.seat_cost))) / NULLIF((SUM(l.seats * l.unit_price)), 0) AS value
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN companies c ON i.company_id = c.company_id JOIN plans p ON l.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE TRUE
GROUP BY p.tier
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100
